changelog: Added Shizuku and root next to ADB: choose how agents reach your phone in Settings → ADB Connect. Agents use adb, Shizuku (rish) or root only when you ask
ADB Connect now reconnects a paired phone by itself when you open it or tap refresh
Fixed Antigravity sign-in: when your Google account isn't allowed, the app now shows why instead of waiting forever
Fixed OpenCode custom providers whose models didn't show up in the model list or in chat (newer OpenCode versions)
Redesigned OpenCode's custom provider editor: full screen, fast with hundreds of models, with search, filters and select all
Added Images, Reasoning and Tools switches for each model of an OpenCode custom provider; "Fetch from endpoint" fills them in from the endpoint, Ollama or models.dev
Added Effort and Thinking controls to OpenCode chats for models that support them, and a warning when you attach an image to a model that can't read images
Added a "Fold after" option for grouped agent steps: how many steps fold into one pill (2 by default)
Agent memory is now on by default; saving chats for agents to look up is now off by default
Added Settings → Updates: get beta updates, and choose how often AntiGem checks for updates in the background
Fixed the app not starting on Android 7 and 8
Back on the main chat screen now moves AntiGem to the background instead of closing it
Fixed a crash on the Claude Code and Codex Plugins pages when the same plugin was installed more than once
Added a Discord community link in Settings → About
Added home screen widgets: Chats (your newest chats), Quick actions, One chat, and Scripts (runs your ~/.shortcuts scripts, like Termux:Widget)
Put any chat on your home screen as its own icon: ⋮ on a chat in the sidebar → Add to home screen, or long-press the chat's title. Browser pages, pages of the app and scripts can get an icon too
Long-press AntiGem's app icon to jump straight into your recent chats
Added Settings → Home screen: add widgets and icons, widget colors (AntiGem theme or wallpaper), background opacity, and an option to hide chat names

Your AntiGem files now show up in Android's file picker and Files app, so other apps can open and save them. The Ubuntu chroot's home folder shows up too. Turn it on or off in Settings → Files in other apps
AntiGem now checks free storage before installing the Linux environment, Android dev tools, REA, the desktop or an app update, and tells you how much to free up instead of failing halfway
Running out of storage during an install now says so clearly, and the half-finished install is removed so it doesn't keep the phone full
Fixed AntiGem crashing when the phone's storage is full
Commands and scripts now show a clear message when the local environment isn't installed yet, instead of failing
Better Android 7 support: Java file features missing on Android 7 now come with the app
Fixed the app icon on Android 7: it showed as a big dark square, now it's a rounded icon the same size as other apps
The IDE's file tree now reads a folder only when you open it, so big projects open fast and use much less memory
The IDE's file tree now updates by itself while the sidebar is open: new, deleted and renamed files show up within a few seconds

Fixed the phone freezing when opening a very big file in the IDE. Files too big for it (text over 5 MB, pictures over 15 MB) are refused before anything is downloaded, with a Share button to open them in another app
The IDE now asks before opening a file that isn't text, before downloading it
The file open in the IDE now reloads only when it changed on disk, instead of being downloaded again every few seconds
Tapping another file while one is still opening in the IDE now cancels the first one, and the file being opened shows a spinner
The floating switcher's pill now shows a ripple when you press it
